map.鹿特丹标准(Rotterdam 2003)：满足以下3项中≥2项即可诊断PCOS: Rotterdam criteria (2003): meet >=2 of the 3 items to diagnose PCOS
map.📖 查看「多囊(鹿特丹)诊断标准器 使用指南」: 📖 View "PCOS (Rotterdam) Diagnostic Standard Tool User Guide"
map.PCOS 鹿特丹诊断：满足 稀发排卵/无排卵、高雄激素表现、多囊卵巢超声 三项中: Rotterdam PCOS: of oligo/anovulation, hyperandrogenism, polycystic ovaries, >=2 of 3; phenotypes A/B/C/D by combination.
map.月经稀发(周期>35天)或闭经(停经>3个月/6个月)、排卵功能障碍: Infrequent menses (cycle >35 days) or amenorrhea (>3/6 months), ovulatory dysfunction
map.临床高雄(多毛、痤疮、脱发)和/或生化高雄(总睾酮/游离睾酮升高): Clinical (hirsutism, acne, alopecia) and/or biochemical (total/free testosterone elevated)
map.单侧或双侧卵巢≥12个直径2–9mm的卵泡，和/或卵巢体积≥10mL: >=12 follicles of 2-9 mm in one/both ovaries, and/or ovarian volume >=10 mL
map.注：诊断PCOS需排除其他高雄激素疾病(先天性肾上腺皮质增生、库欣综合征、分泌雄: Note: PCOS diagnosis must exclude other hyperandrogenic diseases (CAH, Cushing, androgen-secreting tumors, etc.).
map.一线治疗。减重5–10%可改善排卵和代谢，运动150min/周: First-line. Lose 5-10% to improve ovulation and metabolism; 150 min exercise/week
map.周期性孕激素或复方口服避孕药(COC): Cyclic progestin or combined oral contraceptive (COC)
map.来曲唑(一线促排)、克罗米芬、促性腺激素、IVF: Letrozole (first-line ovulation induction), clomiphene, gonadotropins, IVF
map.关注糖耐量、血脂、子宫内膜厚度(内膜癌风险): Watch glucose tolerance, lipids, endometrial thickness (cancer risk)
map.提示：PCOS是排除性诊断。青少年PCOS诊断需谨慎，建议月经紊乱2年以上且高雄: Tip: PCOS is a diagnosis of exclusion. Adolescent PCOS needs caution—menstrual disorder >2 years and persistent hyperandrogenism. All PCOS patients should screen metabolic syndrome. For clinical auxiliary reference only.
map.排除其他高雄疾病后制定方案。: After excluding other hyperandrogenic diseases, plan treatment.
map.稀发排卵 + 高雄激素（多毛/痤疥）+ 多囊卵巢（AFC>12 或体积增大）：满: Oligo-ovulation + hyperandrogenism (hirsutism/acne) + PCO (AFC>12 or enlarged): meets 3 = type A (classic), highest metabolic risk.
map.高雄 + 多囊但排卵正常：满足 2 项，为 C 型，生育力相对较好但仍需评估代谢: Hyperandrogenism + PCO but normal ovulation: meets 2 = type C, relatively better fertility but still assess metabolism.
map.三项：①稀发/无排卵 ②临床或生化高雄 ③超声多囊卵巢；满足任意两项且排除其他病: Three: 1 oligo/anovulation, 2 clinical/biochemical hyperandrogenism, 3 ultrasound PCO; any two plus exclusion = PCOS.
map.高雄也见于先天性肾上腺增生、库欣、雄激素肿瘤等，需查 17-OHP、皮质醇等排除: Hyperandrogenism also occurs in CAH, Cushing, androgen tumors; check 17-OHP, cortisol, etc. before diagnosing PCOS.
map.多囊(鹿特丹)诊断标准器，按鹿特丹标准评估多囊卵巢综合征(PCOS)，需满足3项: The PCOS diagnostic tool evaluates PCOS by Rotterdam, requiring 2 of 3 criteria. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
